exit.scale_plan: Cover the entire position in one order. Do not scale out of a losing short — that is the same mistake in smaller pieces.

catalyst.action: Buy to cover at market the moment the contract opens. This is a closing order, not a new position.

thesis: This is a risk-management close, not a trade. The report is short /MBTU6 from 64,100 and 64,340 with a stated 66,600 stop; Bitcoin is 78,761 and the stop was breached eleven days ago and never honoured. A short future whose stop has been ignored is an uncapped liability that grows with every rally, and September expiry brings a forced roll decision on top of it. Cover.
key_risk: Covering crystallises a roughly 22% loss, and Bitcoin could fall back to 64,000 next week and make this look like the bottom tick. That is the correct trade anyway: the position violated its own risk rule and the alternative is holding an unbounded short on hope.
counter_argument: The original bear thesis may still be right on a six-month view. If so, re-enter deliberately at a level with a fresh stop — do not express it by refusing to close a position that already failed.

Fair — but that is the argument every holder of a parabolic commodity name makes at the high, and it is not a reason to hold full size 0.4% below a 250-day high.
